title: Gold Wyrmling Staff

sources.title: Fire Bolt
markers: | description = Hurl a mote of fire.

summary: A +1 quarterstaff with an extra 1d4 Fire on melee hits and the Fire Bolt cantrip.

fields.Fire Bolt: Action. Make a ranged spell attack out to 60 ft. Deal 1d10 Fire on a hit, rising to 2d10 at character level 5 and 3d10 at level 10.
fields.Dipping and coatings: The linked item notes say dipping and coatings do not apply a damage buff despite the displayed Dippable property.
fields.Base value: 320 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
